file.desc: Csv of users to upload in format member id, email

id.desc: ID of the usergroup to upload users to

desc: Add members to an existing organizational usergroup in bulk via CSV upload. This method is only available to Enterprise Grid organizations.

errors.cannot_modify_role_admin: The user does not have permission to modify the roles admin role.
errors.feature_not_enabled: The Admin APIs feature is not enabled for this workspace.
errors.invalid_usergroup: A usergroup with the specified ID does not exist.
errors.member_count_would_exceed_visible_limit: The usergroup is visible and the member count would exceed the limit.
errors.no_valid_users: There were no valid users provided in the csv.
errors.not_an_enterprise: The token passed in does not belong to an Enterprise organization.
